meta.title: Long-Awaited
meta.description: One step forward and you meet a face you haven't seen in a while.

units.rawText: Soon, we reach the vicinity of Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Soon, we reach the vicinity of Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Soon, we reach the vicinity of Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: As we approach the Sanctifiers, the pursuing Entropics seem to get scared, because fewer and fewer of them follow us.
units.displayText: As we approach the Sanctifiers, the pursuing Entropics seem to get scared, because fewer and fewer of them follow us.

spans.text: As we approach the Sanctifiers, the pursuing Entropics seem to get scared, because fewer and fewer of them follow us.

units.rawText: Antonina's tapping on her keyboard grows less and less frequent, and she looks much more relaxed.
units.displayText: Antonina's tapping on her keyboard grows less and less frequent, and she looks much more relaxed.

spans.text: Antonina's tapping on her keyboard grows less and less frequent, and she looks much more relaxed.

units.rawText: Our pursuers are dwindling in number.
units.displayText: Our pursuers are dwindling in number.

spans.text: Our pursuers are dwindling in number.

units.rawText: That's because this is Sanctifier territory. Surely they wouldn't dare approach.
units.displayText: That's because this is Sanctifier territory. Surely they wouldn't dare approach.

spans.text: That's because this is Sanctifier territory. Surely they wouldn't dare approach.

units.rawText: Is that so?
units.displayText: Is that so?

spans.text: Is that so?

units.rawText: Why do you think that's the case?
units.displayText: Why do you think that's the case?

spans.text: Why do you think that's the case?

units.rawText: If they were going to attack a Sanctifier watchtower, a pack of Low-Order Entropics nipping at our tails wouldn't be able to do it.
units.displayText: If they were going to attack a Sanctifier watchtower, a pack of Low-Order Entropics nipping at our tails wouldn't be able to do it.

spans.text: If they were going to attack a Sanctifier watchtower, a pack of Low-Order Entropics nipping at our tails wouldn't be able to do it.

units.rawText: Odile might assume direct control of the Entropics at any moment, so we need to be prepared for a fight.
units.displayText: Odile might assume direct control of the Entropics at any moment, so we need to be prepared for a fight.

spans.text: Odile might assume direct control of the Entropics at any moment, so we need to be prepared for a fight.

units.rawText: You said you got on Eosphorus' whitelist last time. Hopefully it works out.
units.displayText: You said you got on Eosphorus' whitelist last time. Hopefully it works out.

spans.text: You said you got on Eosphorus' whitelist last time. Hopefully it works out.

units.rawText: At the very least, the Sanctifiers didn't show any sign of aggression just now.
units.displayText: At the very least, the Sanctifiers didn't show any sign of aggression just now.

spans.text: At the very least, the Sanctifiers didn't show any sign of aggression just now.

units.rawText: That's true... At the very least we can give our wounded some treatment.
units.displayText: That's true... At the very least we can give our wounded some treatment.

spans.text: That's true... At the very least we can give our wounded some treatment.

units.rawText: Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!
units.displayText: Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!

spans.text: Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!

units.rawText: It's a signal from inside the watchtower. Put it through.
units.displayText: It's a signal from inside the watchtower. Put it through.

spans.text: It's a signal from inside the watchtower. Put it through.

units.rawText: [This is Sanctifier Watchtower 05.]
units.displayText: [This is Sanctifier Watchtower 05.]

spans.text: [This is Sanctifier Watchtower 05.]

units.rawText: [It has been 10 minutes since the last communication. No large-scale viral movement has been detected.]
units.displayText: [It has been 10 minutes since the last communication. No large-scale viral movement has been detected.]

spans.text: [It has been 10 minutes since the last communication. No large-scale viral movement has been detected.]

units.rawText: The virus might not be on time, but we'll be there right away.
units.displayText: The virus might not be on time, but we'll be there right away.

spans.text: The virus might not be on time, but we'll be there right away.

units.rawText: [Do you require Watchtower gate access Y/N?]
units.displayText: [Do you require Watchtower gate access Y/N?]

spans.text: [Do you require Watchtower gate access Y/N?]

units.rawText: [Y. Please open the gates for us.]
units.displayText: [Y. Please open the gates for us.]

spans.text: [Y. Please open the gates for us.]

units.rawText: [Understood. The request has been processed.]
units.displayText: [Understood. The request has been processed.]

spans.text: [Understood. The request has been processed.]

units.rawText: We've arrived in front of the watchtower during this exchange. As we approach it, the entrance gate slowly opens.
units.displayText: We've arrived in front of the watchtower during this exchange. As we approach it, the entrance gate slowly opens.

spans.text: We've arrived in front of the watchtower during this exchange. As we approach it, the entrance gate slowly opens.

units.rawText: Pioneer team, bring the wounded in first. Antonina and I will watch the flanks.
units.displayText: Pioneer team, bring the wounded in first. Antonina and I will watch the flanks.

spans.text: Pioneer team, bring the wounded in first. Antonina and I will watch the flanks.

units.rawText: Roger!
units.displayText: Roger!

spans.text: Roger!

units.rawText:
We enter the gate and a massive, imposing structure appears before us.
A Lesser Sanctifier emerges from the shadow of the building and slowly floats toward us.
units.displayText:
We enter the gate and a massive, imposing structure appears before us.
A Lesser Sanctifier emerges from the shadow of the building and slowly floats toward us.

spans.text:
We enter the gate and a massive, imposing structure appears before us.
A Lesser Sanctifier emerges from the shadow of the building and slowly floats toward us.

units.rawText: [Welcome to Null Area Watchtower 05.]
units.displayText: [Welcome to Null Area Watchtower 05.]

spans.text: [Welcome to Null Area Watchtower 05.]

units.rawText: Were you the Sanctifier that contacted us just now?
units.displayText: Were you the Sanctifier that contacted us just now?

spans.text: Were you the Sanctifier that contacted us just now?

units.rawText: [Affirmative. Requesting identity verification.]
units.displayText: [Affirmative. Requesting identity verification.]

spans.text: [Affirmative. Requesting identity verification.]

units.rawText: We have authorization from Eosphorus...
units.displayText: We have authorization from Eosphorus...

spans.text: We have authorization from Eosphorus...

units.rawText: Just then, Antonina's equipment emits an alert.
units.displayText: Just then, Antonina's equipment emits an alert.

spans.text: Just then, Antonina's equipment emits an alert.

units.rawText: Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!
units.displayText: Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!

spans.text: Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!

units.rawText: A new communications request?
units.displayText: A new communications request?

spans.text: A new communications request?

units.rawText: Answer it for me if it's Croque. I need to finish up over here.
units.displayText: Answer it for me if it's Croque. I need to finish up over here.

spans.text: Answer it for me if it's Croque. I need to finish up over here.

units.rawText: Yes, yes.
units.displayText: Yes, yes.

spans.text: Yes, yes.

units.rawText: Antonina moves to the rear of the group before taking the call. I turn to the Lesser Sanctifier but find that it is not moving.
units.displayText: Antonina moves to the rear of the group before taking the call. I turn to the Lesser Sanctifier but find that it is not moving.

spans.text: Antonina moves to the rear of the group before taking the call. I turn to the Lesser Sanctifier but find that it is not moving.

units.rawText: What's wrong?
units.displayText: What's wrong?

spans.text: What's wrong?

units.rawText: [Access verification incomplete. Approach to confirm identity.]
units.displayText: [Access verification incomplete. Approach to confirm identity.]

spans.text: [Access verification incomplete. Approach to confirm identity.]

units.rawText: Alright.
units.displayText: Alright.

spans.text: Alright.

units.rawText: Why are you alone? Where are the other Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: Why are you alone? Where are the other Sanctifiers?

spans.text: Why are you alone? Where are the other Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: [They are deeper within.]
units.displayText: [They are deeper within.]

spans.text: [They are deeper within.]

units.rawText: Deeper within? Since when did Lesser Sanctifiers use such abstract expressions? Or is this an expression like the use of "Daemon"?
units.displayText: Deeper within? Since when did Lesser Sanctifiers use such abstract expressions? Or is this an expression like the use of "Daemon"?

spans.text: Deeper within? Since when did Lesser Sanctifiers use such abstract expressions? Or is this an expression like the use of "Daemon"?

units.rawText: As I mutter to myself, I inspect the surroundings.
units.displayText: As I mutter to myself, I inspect the surroundings.

spans.text: As I mutter to myself, I inspect the surroundings.

units.rawText: The interior of the watchtower is quiet and clean, but there is no sign of anyone else.
units.displayText: The interior of the watchtower is quiet and clean, but there is no sign of anyone else.

spans.text: The interior of the watchtower is quiet and clean, but there is no sign of anyone else.

units.rawText: ...Hold on, everyone. Something's not quite right.
units.displayText: ...Hold on, everyone. Something's not quite right.

spans.text: ...Hold on, everyone. Something's not quite right.

units.rawText: [Deeper within... They... will arrive soon...]
units.displayText: [Deeper within... They... will arrive soon...]

spans.text: [Deeper within... They... will arrive soon...]

units.rawText: All units, fall back now!
units.displayText: All units, fall back now!

spans.text: All units, fall back now!

units.rawText: [Deeper within... is here.]
units.displayText: [Deeper within... is here.]

spans.text: [Deeper within... is here.]

units.rawText: Within the space of that sentence, the Sanctifier's voice shifts to that of a woman's, and its white exterior quickly deepens in color.
units.displayText: Within the space of that sentence, the Sanctifier's voice shifts to that of a woman's, and its white exterior quickly deepens in color.

spans.text: Within the space of that sentence, the Sanctifier's voice shifts to that of a woman's, and its white exterior quickly deepens in color.

units.rawText: [Welcome to... Watchtower 05, Professor <cmdr>.]
units.displayText: [Welcome to... Watchtower 05, Professor {교수}.]

spans.text: [Welcome to... Watchtower 05, Professor

units.rawText: It is a voice that could not be any more familiar to me.
units.displayText: It is a voice that could not be any more familiar to me.

spans.text: It is a voice that could not be any more familiar to me.

units.rawText: [Let us begin today's performance...]
units.displayText: [Let us begin today's performance...]

spans.text: [Let us begin today's performance...]

units.rawText: [Welcome to... what I have prepared for you...!]
units.displayText: [Welcome to... what I have prepared for you...!]

spans.text: [Welcome to... what I have prepared for you...!]

units.rawText: The Entropized Sanctifier extrudes savage tentacles toward me. I reflexively leap back, but feel a cool wind at the back of my neck.
units.displayText: The Entropized Sanctifier extrudes savage tentacles toward me. I reflexively leap back, but feel a cool wind at the back of my neck.

spans.text: The Entropized Sanctifier extrudes savage tentacles toward me. I reflexively leap back, but feel a cool wind at the back of my neck.

units.rawText: Crap, it was a feint—
units.displayText: Crap, it was a feint—

spans.text: Crap, it was a feint—

units.rawText: I hear a sharp blade cleaving through the air close by, an ambusher from behind that I cannot possibly avoid. And then—
units.displayText: I hear a sharp blade cleaving through the air close by, an ambusher from behind that I cannot possibly avoid. And then—

spans.text: I hear a sharp blade cleaving through the air close by, an ambusher from behind that I cannot possibly avoid. And then—

units.rawText: Professor!
units.displayText: Professor!

spans.text: Professor!

units.rawText: (Stab)
units.displayText: (Stab)

spans.text: (Stab)

units.rawText: (Coughs)
units.displayText: Coughs

spans.text: Coughs

units.rawText: Antonina!
units.displayText: Antonina!

spans.text: Antonina!

units.rawText: It's an ambush... Professor...
units.displayText: It's an ambush... Professor...

spans.text: It's an ambush... Professor...

units.rawText: A purplish-black claw has impaled Antonina's shoulder.
units.displayText: A purplish-black claw has impaled Antonina's shoulder.

spans.text: A purplish-black claw has impaled Antonina's shoulder.

units.rawText: Behind Antonina's body, Odile smirks at me.
units.displayText: Behind Antonina's body, Odile smirks at me.

spans.text: Behind Antonina's body, Odile smirks at me.

units.rawText: Welcome to the stage I have prepared for you.
units.displayText: Welcome to the stage I have prepared for you.

spans.text: Welcome to the stage I have prepared for you.

units.rawText: Did you enjoy this welcome?
units.displayText: Did you enjoy this welcome?

spans.text: Did you enjoy this welcome?
